title: SQLModel + Python 3.14 compatibility
content: SQLModel 0.0.19 and 0.0.20 have known incompatibility with Python 3.14. The 'Optional' type without subscript causes failures in pydantic model construction. Use 'int | None' syntax or migrate to pure SQLAlchemy 2.0 with mapped_column.
example:
# Wrong
id: Optional = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)

# Correct
id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)

title: SQLModel Session usage
content: SQLModel uses .exec() for queries, not .execute(). session.exec(select(Model)) returns results directly.
example:
with Session(engine) as session:
    users = session.exec(select(User)).all()

title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 as SQLModel alternative
content: When SQLModel has compatibility issues, use SQLAlchemy 2.0 directly with DeclarativeBase and mapped_column for full Python 3.14 support.
example:
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'user'
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(unique=True)
